meaning: A setup that pays a bill for you from your bank account or card on a set date. You do not pay each time.
clues: It moves money without you pressing a button each time.
The money goes out of your account, not in.
It pays a bill on a set date, like your phone or electric bill.
You must keep enough money in the account, and you can stop it if you change your mind.
It is one word with seven letters. It starts with A and sounds like "automatic" plus "pay".
assumes: Direct deposit puts money into your account
A paper check is signed and sent each time

decoys.meaning: Your pay or benefits go straight into your bank account by computer, with no paper check.
A way to send money from one bank account to another, often to a faraway place.
A paper note that tells your bank to pay money from your account to someone.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, we mailed a paper check every month and licked the stamp.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: It is handy, but look over your statement each month. You can also stop it if you change your mind.
